verdict.rationale: The official overview says Claude Code "works directly with git" and "stages changes, writes commit messages, creates branches, and opens pull requests," which matches every element of the story. Other first-party material reinforces it: GitHub/GitLab integration for submitting PRs, a "create a PR on GitHub" MCP example, Slack-to-PR routing, and the README's mention of handling git workflows. Community discussion of leaked commit/PR-message instructions indirectly confirms it authors commit messages and PR descriptions. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of the git/PR workflow (e.g. branch naming or PR description controls), and independent hands-on reports of the full stage-commit-branch-PR flow working.
